nodes.klein: to contract, draw in, take in. he contracted, was stunted (in the Bible occurring only in the pass. part. קָלוּט); he received, took in; he absorbed, restrained; it served as a city of refuge; he took off, removed. it was absorbed, entered; it struck roots; was received or adopted (e.g. a word into a language); was gathered, was collected. he recorded. was recorded.
